item.title: Wallabies reduced to 11 men in chaotic upset win over world champ Boks

item.title: Irish players to wear black armbands to boycott Israel
item.description: Ireland’s national football team is facing intense pressure to boycott its UEFA Nations League games against Israel, with the first match taking place this Sunday evening in Hungary. The team has decided to go ahead with the fixture but will wear black armbands in protest. Ireland will also be without its usual goalkeeper, who has chosen to boycott the game. Antonia Kerrigan reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Hong Kong Stadium could host tennis events amid Victoria Park court upgrade: minister
item.description: Hong Kong Stadium could serve as an interim home for major tennis tournaments during the redevelopment of Victoria Park’s centre court, the city’s sports minister has said, adding that the government will seek to attract higher-level events even before the new facility is ready. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui said on Sunday that authorities could reserve the stadium for tennis during certain periods each year and install temporary courts and other facilities.
